messages:
Ria: Quick sync: proposing we add per-model weight-class quotas (tiny/small/medium/large/xlarge) on top of org quotas so heavy models don't starve smaller ones.
Jordan: SGTM. Where do we enforce? router or api-gateway?
Alim: Router preferred. We already pick model there and can decrement counters close to execution. Downside: console needs extra events to show why a request was throttled.
Marta: Console needs clear UX for soft vs hard throttle. Soft -> 429 + Retry-After + inline banner with suggestion. Hard -> 403 + help link + contact.
Sam: Implementation sketch (pseudoconfig):
```
quota_profile:
  org_default: tokens_per_min=60000
  weight_classes:
    tiny: tokens_per_min=25000
    small: tokens_per_min=15000
    medium: tokens_per_min=8000
    large: tokens_per_min=3000, burst=2000
    xlarge: tokens_per_min=1000, burst=500
```
Router decrements both org and model-class buckets. If model-class empty -> soft throttle first, escalate to hard block after N soft breaches.
Jordan: How do we handle multi-model pipelines or calling tools that fan out? Risk of double- or missed-charging.
Alim: Charge each downstream model for tokens it produces. For pipeline requests, compute per-model usage after generation and validate against each model bucket. If any model violated, apply the model-specific policy to the whole request (soft/hard).
Ria: Streaming edge: we can't know final token count. Approach: optimistic allowance (allow streaming until bucket consumed), emit streaming-meter events, reconcile after completion. If we overshot, flag for billing reconciliation and show an "over quota" notice in the session history. We should avoid cutting a token mid-stream unless hard cap is reached.
Marta: UI details for streaming: live usage bar, amber toast for soft-throttle with suggestion: "Try smaller model". Keep copy short.
Sam: Telemetry fields to emit per request: model_family, weight_class, tokens_requested_estimate, tokens_returned, throttle_type (none/soft/hard), remaining_model_tokens, remaining_org_tokens. Also record histograms tokens/sec by weight_class.
quota-bot: Staging: per-model counters drained to zero for 6 orgs during smoke tests — see /incidents/312 for logs.
Jordan: Rollout plan: feature-flagged by org cohort. Phase1: router emits soft-throttle events + metrics (no hard blocking). Phase2: enable hard caps for free-tier and low-usage orgs. Phase3: console allows per-org exceptions and overrides.
Alim: Limiter implementation: token-bucket with burst credits per weight-class to allow short bursts while preserving fairness. Sliding window breaks predictability for bursts.
Ria: Admin operations: need admin API to set per-org/per-weight overrides and an audit log. Also CLI to bulk move orgs to new profiles.
Marta: Suggested customer message: "Your requests to large models are limited by quota. Try a smaller model or request increased capacity via support." Short and actionable.
Sam: Tests: synthetic mixed-model workload (ensembles, streaming, function calls). Verify counters never go negative, console meter matches remaining_model_tokens emitted, and soft->hard escalation works.
Jordan: Billing: bill on actual tokens_returned. Use throttles for runtime control only. Any large post-hoc reconciliation should create a support ticket for customer ops.
Ria: Action items:
- Sam: PR for router: dual-counter decrement + soft-throttle behavior (due in 3d)
- Alim: prototype token-bucket with configurable burst credits in test harness (due in 5d)
- Marta: console mockups + copy for banners/meter (due in 5d)
- Jordan: rollout plan doc + feature flags and cohorts (due in 4d)
- DevEx: add smoke tests for ensembles and streaming (cc @DevEx)
Ria: If anyone objects to soft-first approach, speak now or comment on the PR. :thumbsup:
